cohort: Forty-six (26 male) ventilated newborn infants with a median gestational age of 34.8 (33.1-36.3) weeks and birth weight of 2.34 (1.77-2.87) kg were studied after 5 (2-10) hours of invasive ventilation in a tertiary neonatal unit.
finding: The prone position in ventilated neonates was associated with improved ventilation to perfusion matching and lower intrapulmonary shunting and alveolar dead space compared to supine positioning.
cross-section timing: Acute measurements were taken after 5 (2-10) hours of invasive ventilation.
